details: The European Central Bank (ECB) has issued a significant warning, stating that stablecoins pose a major threat to the traditional banking system and overall financial stability. The concern stems from the potential for customers to shift funds from banks to crypto and stablecoins, which could deplete bank reserves and impact profitability. The ECB is reportedly developing its own digital euro as a potential alternative.
title: ECB Warns Stablecoins Threaten Banking System

details: Global central banks are maintaining a cautious and restrictive monetary policy stance, which continues to limit investor confidence and appetite for risk assets like cryptocurrencies. This is evidenced by subdued short-term demand and fragile market confidence, with analysts noting the possibility of continued aggressive central bank policies in the near future.
title: Central Banks' Restrictive Policies Dampen Crypto Market Confidence

details: Bitcoin has experienced a dip, falling below $63,000 to a two-week low. This downturn is attributed to weaker-than-expected earnings reports from major cryptocurrency platforms such as Coinbase Global Inc., coupled with a general fading of optimism surrounding anticipated U.S. crypto legislation. This suggests that speculative investors may be pulling back from the market.
title: Bitcoin Dips as Coinbase Earnings Disappoint, Optimism Wanes

details: The broader cryptocurrency market is undergoing a correction, with Bitcoin trading below $64,000 and altcoins like Ethereum and XRP facing increased selling pressure. This market weakness is largely driven by ongoing macroeconomic uncertainty and escalating geopolitical tensions, particularly in the Middle East, which tend to foster a risk-off sentiment among investors.
title: Crypto Market Corrects on Macro Uncertainty & Geopolitical Tensions
